items.toString: NB-04: Upload Application and Supporting Documents

The broker sends the signed application and loss runs via email. I need to attach these to the submission record in the Workbench so they are centrally stored and linked to the member.

|#|Acceptance Criteria|
|1|User can drag-and-drop or browse to select files on the Documents tab.|
|2|System supports the following document types:|

||#||Document Type||
|1|Renewal Application|
|2|New Business Application (UE Form)|
|3|ACORD Application|
|4|Broker Cover Letter / Email|
|5|Bind Order Email|
|6|Audited Financial Statements|
|7|Loss Runs (6 Year)|
|8|Inception to Date Loss Run|
|9|6 Year Loss Ratio Report|
|10|SOV / Exposure Data|
|11|TBI Application|
|12|Concussion Management Plan (CMP)|
|13|Underwriting Notes (UW Notes)|
|14|Financial Distress Model (FDM) Output|
|15|Premium Planning Spreadsheet|
|16|Referral Documentation|
|17|Quote Letter / Proposal|
|18|Binder & Invoice|
|19|Policy Documents|
|20|Endorsement Forms|
|21|Legal Notice / Non-Renewal Letter|
|22|Claims Follow-up Emails|
|23|RMPC Status / MBR Report|
|24|Policy Comparison Summary|
|25|Endorsement Lookup Report|

|#|Acceptance Criteria|
|3|System automatically runs an initial Virus Scan on uploaded files.|
|4|System links the uploaded file to the specific Submission ID.|
|5|User to manually-classify the document|
|6|User can rename the file or add a description before saving.|

*Navigation*:

Homepage/Submissions

*Story:*

|*As a*|Underwriter / Business User|
|*I want to*|view all submissions in a paginated table with key details per row|
|*So that*|I can view, sort, and navigate submissions efficiently without opening each record|

*Fields & Behavior* 

|*Field*|*Section*|*Type*|*Behavior*|*Validation*|
|Member / Institution|Table|Hyperlink + Sub ID|Account name as hyperlink; shows SUB-ID, state, brokerage below|—|
|Type|Table|Badge|Displays submission type (e.g., New Biz, Cross-sell)|—|
|Products|Table|Tag Pills|Selected products shown as pill badges (EPL, ELL, GL, Cyber, ML, etc.)|—|
|Stage|Table|Colored Badge|Grey = New, Amber = In Review, Green = Bound, etc. (Color Coding TBD)|—|
|Premium|Table|Currency + Enrolled|Shows premium amount and enrolled count (Enrolled Logic TBD)|—|
|Underwriter|Table|Avatar + Name|Shows initials avatar + name; 'Unassigned' with warning icon if empty|—|
|Appetite|Table|Progress Bar + %|Displays appetite score as a percentage with visual bar (logic TBD)|—|
|Age|Table|Elapsed Time|Time since creation (e.g., ‘3d’, '1Hr'|If age is less than a day show in hrs else days.|
|Need By|Table|Date|Target date for completion|—|
|Effective|Table|Date|Policy effective date|—|

*Key Rules*

* Default sort is by most recently active or created

* Columns with ↑↓ arrows are sortable (*Member / Institution, Stage, Premium, Appetite, Age)* clicking toggles ascending/descending 

* Pagination footer shows: Showing X–Y of N submissions · Page Z of M

* Previous/Next and numbered page controls are available

* Clicking a row or account name navigates to the Submission Detail page

*Acceptance Criteria*

* Table displays all 10 columns: Member/Institution, Type, Products, Stage, Premium, Underwriter, Appetite, Age, Need By, Effective

* Each row shows account name as a hyperlink, SUB-ID, state abbreviation, and brokerage

* Stage badges are color-coded consistently across the list

* Unassigned submissions show a warning icon in the Underwriter column

* Pagination controls are visible and functional

* Clicking a row navigates to the Submission Detail page; URL updates to /submissions/{SUB-ID}

*Dependencies:*  Live submission data from Workbench database
